title: Saffron Shield Claims Q&A
instructions: Rejection rate ALWAYS means rejected claims / DECIDED claims (decided = approved + rejected + settled). A claim still at 'submitted' has not been decided - it is on neither side of the fraction. Never divide by all claims.
Paid = approved amount of SETTLED claims only.
Weekly = Monday-starting week of the submission date.
Plan = the plan version at the claim's admission (fact_claims.plan_sk), never the member's current plan.
Loss ratios in this data are far above 1 - that is expected; do not 'fix' it.

trusted_examples.name: Claims per status
trusted_examples.sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS claim_count FROM claims.analytics.fact_claims GROUP BY status

trusted_examples.name: Hospitals with the most rejections last admission month (rejection rate over DECIDED, NULLIF guard)
trusted_examples.sql: SELECT h.hospital_id, h.hospital_name, SUM(CASE WHEN f.status = 'rejected' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rejected_claims, SUM(CASE WHEN f.status IN ('approved','rejected','settled') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS decided_claims, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN f.status = 'rejected' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN f.status IN ('approved','rejected','settled') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 4) AS rejection_rate FROM claims.analytics.fact_claims f JOIN claims.analytics.dim_hospital h ON f.hospital_sk = h.hospital_sk JOIN claims.analytics.dim_date d ON f.admission_date_key = d.date_key WHERE d.month_start = (SELECT MAX(month_start) FROM claims.analytics.dim_date) GROUP BY h.hospital_id, h.hospital_name ORDER BY rejected_claims DESC LIMIT 10

trusted_examples.name: Monthly claim volume and billing trend
trusted_examples.sql: SELECT d.month_start, COUNT(*) AS claim_count, ROUND(SUM(f.billed_amount), 2) AS total_billed FROM claims.analytics.fact_claims f JOIN claims.analytics.dim_date d ON f.admission_date_key = d.date_key GROUP BY d.month_start ORDER BY d.month_start

trusted_examples.name: Rejection codes driving rejections (share of all rejections)
trusted_examples.sql: SELECT f.rejection_code, COUNT(*) AS rejected_count, ROUND(COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 4) AS share_of_rejections FROM claims.analytics.fact_claims f WHERE f.status = 'rejected' GROUP BY f.rejection_code ORDER BY rejected_count DESC

sample_question_shapes: How many claims are in each status?
Which hospitals had the most rejections last month, and what is their rejection rate over decided claims?
How do claim volume and billed amount trend by month?
Which rejection codes drive our rejections?
coverage_note: The 4 trusted examples cover the four canonical question shapes (status counts, hospital rejections with decided-only rate, monthly trend, rejection codes). The 10 benchmark questions reuse these shapes with different entities, months, and wordings - they are held out, not reworded copies of the examples. Trusted example count (4) and sample question count (4) both exceed the rubric minimum of 3.
